name: fairclinic-vaccine-reminders
description: Fairclinic Vaccine Reminders: reads the veterinary practice system's reminder list for pets that are overdue and not booked, overdue with no recent reminder, due soon with no reminder, clients with no e-mail or phone, and reminders sent for pets marked deceased or inactive. Due dates come from your system; it never sets a schedule or sends a reminder. Pet and client names are masked before results reach the model.
